parsed.name: HP 3488A 开关控制单元
parsed.description: 一款可编程模块化开关控制主机，可安装不同类型的开关卡或继电器卡，在自动化测试与测量系统中用于信号切换、通道复用和仪器/被测件之间的连接路由。
parsed.description_en: A programmable modular switch/control mainframe that accepts different switch or relay cards and is used in automated test and measurement systems for signal switching, channel multiplexing, and routing connections between instruments and devices under test.
